<section class="home-csr">
<div class="row">
<div class="col-md-3 section-heading">
<h2>Sustainability</h2>
<a class="more" href="/en/substainability">More<svg class="icon icon-arrow-right"><use xlink:href="/App_Themes/KNPCEnglish/images/symbol-defs.svg#icon-arrow-right"></use></svg></a>
</div>
<div class="col-md-9 csr-item">
<h3><a href="/en/substainability">Sustainability</a></h3>
<p>
At KNPC the three pillars of sustainability reporting initiatives is society, along with economic contribution and environmental protection. The community around the operating facilitates are our core stakeholders. Their safety, health and well-being is our main priority. Giving back to society has always been the forefront of the company’s strategic contributions. KNPC has been completely involved with giving back to charities and sponsorships especially those that focus on education, environmental enhancements, health and safety awareness, special needs education and well-being, as well as participating in cultural events .
</p>
</div>
</div>
